snippet.title: Hostile Lands - Early Access Launch Trailer - Pixel Art Roguelite Top-Down Shooter - Indie Game
snippet.description:
Hostile Lands is a 2D top-down, Roguelike shooter where a crash landing is mistaken for an act of war. LOOT tons of unique guns. ENHANCE your skills. RESCUE surviving crew members and ESCAPE...if you can. 

Available Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075890/Hostile_Lands/

Made with @GameMakerEngine 

#roguelike #steam #earlyaccess
